book.universityguide.page.1:
Welcome to UVG

Find a university guide and right-click it to view destinations.

This book explains how to take the tour.
book.universityguide.page.2:
Choose a destination

The menu shows each name and distance. Click a place to start the tour.

Only stops within 250 blocks of the guide appear. Ask the organizer if a stop is missing.
book.universityguide.page.3:
Follow the guide

Stay close to the guide. It waits when the group falls behind.

Use the stairs and slabs along the route. The guide opens compatible doors, but avoids obstacles and restricted areas.
book.universityguide.page.4:
When you arrive

Information about the place appears. Close that screen to explore.

To choose another destination, right-click an available guide again.
book.universityguide.page.5:
If something goes wrong

If the guide cannot find a route, ask the organizer to check the path or select another stop.

You can recover this book with:
/universityguide book
